reviewer: Claude review agent reviewer-mi-2, independent of the extractor lit-microbial-interactions; no human review claimed
scope: Independent review of lit-interactions-20261011-ppiemb: 715 records (308 results). Re-downloaded the PMC full-text XML and matched its SHA-256. Parsed all 308 cells (2 tables x 2 datasets x 7 rows x 11 columns) with an independent parser: all match and no cell was missed. Read 42 values from the PMC HTML rendering: 42 of 42 match. The three prose-versus-table discrepancies were confirmed, and none of the six percentage gains in the first Results paragraph can be derived from Table 5.
limitations: Automated review by a Claude agent; not human scientific review and not reproduction of any result.
Supplementary Tables S1 to S7 were not retrieved, including the OGB leaderboard values the evidence concern refers to, so the leaderboard comparison in the concern is unverified.
The Europe PMC PDF render was blocked by a Cloudflare challenge, so the hand check used the PMC HTML rendering.
Corrections were applied by the extractor in the extraction script, as the reviewer specified; see review.md.
